[[File:Mason EP247.png|thumb|250px|Mason]] '''Mason''' is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP247|Outrageous Fortunes]]''. He was unnamed in the Japanese version. Mason was the seventh consecutive {{pkmn|Trainer}} to battle [[Delaney]]. He hoped that his {{p|Hitmontop}} would be able to put an end to {{p|Poliwrath}}'s winning streak. However, Delaney proved to be more powerful and defeated the young Trainer's {{type|Fighting}} Pokémon. {{-}} ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|java|enva|scope=section}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Mason |pkmn=Hitmontop |gender=male |type1=Fighting |img=Mason Hitmontop.png |epnum=EP247 |epname=Outrageous Fortunes |vajp= |vaen= |desc={{p|Hitmontop}} was one of the Pokémon battling Delaney's {{p|Poliwrath}}. It wasn't long before Poliwrath was able to defeat Hitmontop with its move combination. Hitmontop's only known move is {{m|Triple Kick}}.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{fighting color}}|bordercolor={{fighting color light}} |ja=愛河里花子 ''[[Rikako Aikawa]]'' |en=[[List of English voice actors|Mason Ripka]] |pl=Mikołaj Klimek}}
